page_title: Kantor: Sheets, Docs and Slides for Windows, Mac and Linux

sources.entry: Kantor - Native office suite (Sheets, Docs, Slides) that opens and saves Excel, Word and PowerPoint files. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/dzulfikar08/kantor) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Kantor
summary.one_liner: Kantor is a small, offline office suite with Sheets, Docs and Slides apps that open and save Excel, Word and PowerPoint files, plus a PDF reader and editor.
keywords: free office for windows mac linux
use_cases: edit Excel or Word files without Microsoft Office
work on documents offline without an account
combine, split and sign PDF files
edit files on a Nextcloud or WebDAV server
batch stamp, fill and sign many PDFs
summary.what_it_does: Kantor provides three apps: Sheets for spreadsheets (.xlsx, .csv, .ods, .xls) with formulas, charts, pivot tables and conditional formatting; Docs for documents (.docx, .doc, .rtf) with tracked changes, comments and page setup; and Slides for presentations (.pptx, .ppt) with speaker notes and slide show. It tries to keep content it does not understand, such as Word equations or Excel form controls, and writes it back on save. It can also open, reorder, merge, split, annotate, fill, and digitally sign PDF files, and run batch operations on folders. Files stay on the local computer, and the interface is available in English and Indonesian.
notable: Opens and saves Microsoft Office formats (.xlsx, .docx, .pptx) and also reads legacy .doc, .xls and .ppt files
Works offline with no account; open source and listed as freeware in awesome-mac
Built-in MCP support so AI assistants like Claude can edit open documents, with each change undoable
Opens and saves files on Nextcloud, OpenCloud or any WebDAV server with conflict checks
caveats: Some features need a paid provider account, such as e-meterai (VIDA, Mekari Sign) or certified signatures (Xignature)
AI features are off by default and require the user's own API key or a local Ollama model
Kantor does not understand every Office feature; unsupported content is preserved, but some saves may go to a new file or warn about what is lost
